# Local frontend dependencies

Runtime assets are served locally; no CDN or Node.js installation is needed.

| Package | Version | Included files | License |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| [Three.js](https://github.com/mrdoob/three.js) | 0.186.1 | `three.module.js`, `three.core.js` | `three.LICENSE` |
| [uPlot](https://github.com/leeoniya/uPlot) | 1.6.32 | `uPlot.iife.min.js`, `uPlot.min.css` | `uplot.LICENSE` |

Files are extracted unchanged from the corresponding npm release tarballs.
